answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a refundable deposit that only unlocks after sustained, verifiable work over a long horizon: every new identity must first complete a chain of small, distinct, independently checked tasks. Cloning a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand deposits plus a thousand histories to fake, while honest agents earn their stake back. Think of it as a sonnet, not a shout: strict form constrains impostors. Trust becomes velvet-smooth for the proven and prohibitively expensive for the copied.
